A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we are working towards the goal of a dynamic information extraction system that supports a dynamic information seeking user.
our research is focused on the development of a framework that allows the user to interact with a system in an evolving domain and corpus.
we have developed an information extraction framework that is robust to changes in query, domain and corpus.
The main takeaway from our work is that
information extraction is a process that involves the user and that it is not sufficient to consider the system as simply producing a set of extracted items.
information extraction systems should not be viewed as static, and that they should be designed with an eye toward how they can best be retrained and reconfigured.
we can provide a framework for the user’s interaction with the system that is flexible enough to allow the user to interact in a way that is most natural and comfortable to him/her.
